meta.phase-name: Bundle-Backed Escape the Dungeon Gameplay and Agent Surface Wiring

phase-summary.outcome: Escape the Dungeon gameplay, browser report generation, replay viewing, MCP session creation, and the KAPLAY play surface now consume the active authored bundle by default when one is present. The playable game path is no longer split between schema/editor tooling and static runtime content.

file.description: Added shared helpers to read the active bundle payload, content packs, and bundle signature so all gameplay surfaces resolve the same authored content source.
Play iframe now reloads against the active authored bundle instead of always booting the default static content-pack URL.
KAPLAY runtime now supports active-authored-bundle boot, passes bundle packs into gameplay creation, and isolates autosaves by content signature.
Game bridge creation/load now accepts runtime content packs and slot ids so authored content and autosave state stay aligned.
Browser report generation now uses the active authored content packs when present.
Game Value generation and replay viewing now follow the active authored bundle instead of static runtime defaults.
Replay reconstruction now accepts runtime content packs so authored content remains visible when seeking through a run.
Runtime playthrough generation remains bundle-aware and now typechecks cleanly against the stabilized engine/runtime exports.
Remote gameplay sessions create engine instances with authored content packs, keeping MCP gameplay aligned with browser gameplay.
MCP create-session input remains bundle-aware and now matches the stable engine package type exports.
Cutscene runtime is now driven from the cutscene content pack instead of a duplicated hard-coded list.
Cutscene pack now contains full trigger metadata and text, making runtime cutscene behavior pack-driven.

commands.command: pnpm --dir docs-site exec vitest run tests/unit/runtime-content-overrides.test.ts tests/unit/overlay-warnings.test.ts tests/unit/content-pack-bundle-build-route.test.ts tests/unit/content-schema-documents.test.ts tests/unit/space-explorer-stat-set-state.test.ts

decision.summary: When an authored content bundle is active in the docs-site app, gameplay surfaces should consume it by default rather than silently falling back to static built-in content.
decision.impact: Browser play, replay, report generation, and MCP session creation stay aligned with the authored schema/content flow.

decision.summary: Cutscene behavior should be driven from the cutscene content pack rather than a duplicated runtime-only table.
decision.impact: Removes one more static content path leak and keeps gameplay presentation tied to generated/imported content.

next.action: Phase 56 runtime closure is complete; move planning attention to the next schema-driven world-authoring phase rather than reopening bundle/playability alignment work.
